units.source_text: 我不明白这是什么意思。

en.t: I did not understand what this meant.

units.source_text: 然而，他那双蓝眼睛从高生命令我。

en.t: Yet those blue eyes of his commanded me from above.

units.source_text: 他的宽阔的肩膀后面，罩上雪花的金阁灿烂辉煌，

en.t: Behind his broad shoulders, the snow-covered Golden Pavilion shone brilliantly,

units.source_text: 洗过似的冬季的蓝天，充满了潮湿的空气。

en.t: and the washed-clean winter blue sky was filled with damp air.

units.source_text: 他的蓝眼睛没有露有一丝残酷。

en.t: His blue eyes showed not the slightest trace of cruelty.

units.source_text: 这瞬间我为什么竟感到人世间也是抒情的呢？

en.t: Why, in that instant, did I somehow feel that the human world too was lyrical?
